meta.title: Terminal-grade intelligence social campaign
meta.summary: Image-first visual territories for a real-time intelligence dashboard marketed to market researchers, equity researchers, situation monitors, and terminal-style research teams.
meta.brief: Create a clear marketing campaign and visual system for X, Instagram, and broader social media. Emphasize analyst-grade monitoring, cross-domain situational awareness, and confidence without implying certainty from unavailable or simulated data.
meta.audience: Market researchers, equity researchers, situation monitors, Bloomberg Terminal users, and research teams.
assumptions: No final brand palette or typography was supplied, so this first pass explores restrained professional palettes.
Images should feel credible to terminal users without copying any third-party terminal interface.
Visual references may show abstract interface structure, but not readable data, logos, exact product screens, or unsupported live claims.

signals.goal: make the application feel like a serious research command surface for live global, market, and risk monitoring
signals.paletteDirection: deep graphite, near-black glass, crisp white, signal green, alert amber, electric cyan, restrained red
signals.emotionalRegister: focused, exacting, high-trust, research-led, quietly urgent
avoid: collages, grids, contact sheets, or mini mood boards
visualPrinciples: product as proof object without invented customer data
use abstracted UI structure rather than fake dashboards
leave negative space useful for later social copy
keep the quality bar serious and editorial

items.title: After-hours terminal desk
items.caption: A focused researcher work surface that feels premium, quiet, and always on.
items.source: Audience cue: terminal-style market and situation researchers.
items.motif: single workstation, abstract dashboard glow, notebook, dark glass desk
items.prompt: Single editorial photograph of an after-hours analyst desk in a dark research office, one large monitor showing an abstract non-readable intelligence dashboard structure with map silhouettes and panel blocks, no logos, no readable text, no real numbers, no brand marks. Include a notebook, matte black keyboard, soft task light, glass reflection, restrained signal green and amber accents. Premium terminal-grade atmosphere, shallow depth of field, high trust, calm urgency, social campaign visual reference.

A lone analyst silhouette stands at a distance for scale. The image should feel like cross-domain situational awareness for markets, infrastructure, conflict, and supply chain monitoring. Matte graphite surfaces, precise green and red accents, high-end financial research mood, shallow depth of field.

The composition suggests deduping noisy feeds into meaningful clusters. Macro lens, dark graphite, teal and blue light, precise and credible, not sci-fi fantasy.

style.promptHint: Use more negative space, cleaner lighting, and a more composed editorial layout.

items.title: Situation monitor command
items.caption: A credible command surface for live monitoring without fake detail.
items.source: Product cue: situation room, live intel, map layers, videos, and panels.

One empty chair, headset, and clean desk imply readiness. The mood is controlled urgency, analyst-grade confidence, and cross-domain monitoring. Dark graphite room, amber alert glow and restrained green status light, believable and not theatrical.
